text:
jamie: Heads-up: PR #5340 failing snippet CI. The JS quickstart uses `instruction` + `input` which our runtime no longer accepts. Tests expect `messages` and numeric `max_new_tokens`.

noor: Saw the failure log. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5340

pat: Can you paste the failing curl/python snippets?

jamie: Sure. Bad curl sample in docs/quickstart.md:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-2","instruction":"Summarize","max_new_tokens":"200","input":"This is a long text..."}'
```
This breaks the schema validator (quoted number, legacy keys). Should be:
```
{"model":"redwood-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize
This is a long text..."}],"max_new_tokens":200}
```
Also missing `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` header in the curl block.

noor: Oof. The JS quickstart uses `client.generate({instruction: '...', input: '...'})` in examples; our JS SDK moved to `client.generate({messages: [...]})` last quarter. That's why the JS snippet runner fails.

pat: I'll update the examples. Quick plan: replace instruction/input with messages array, coerce quoted numerics to numbers, add Content-Type to curl, and rename any `vector` response fields to `embedding` in embed examples.

ci-bot: docs-snippet-lint failed for PR 5340 (snip-079): quoted numerics and legacy keys detected

noor: Two additional things I noticed:
- api-ref/generate.yaml example still includes `timeout_ms: 1000` but the schema marks it nullable/optional. If CI compares example to schema, best to omit or set to null.
- streaming example in samples/streaming.md uses ad-hoc SSE payloads with `{role,content}`. Our streaming parser expects events with `type` and `delta` (chat-stream contract).

jamie: Good catches. Pat, can you add a short comment in the YAML near `timeout_ms` explaining why examples omit it so folks don't re-add it accidentally?

pat: Will do. Also adding a tiny test in snippet-linter to reject quoted numbers in JSON example bodies (snip-080). That should trap regressions early.

noor: One more request: community contribution examples in community-contrib/ use a mix of `input`, `inputs`, and `messages`. We should pick canonical `messages` in docs and add a short migration note in samples/compat.md describing legacy aliases.

pat: Agreed. I'll add a compat section: "Legacy aliases: input/inputs -> messages" and mention runtime still accepts them but docs show canonical shape.

jamie: Also, please normalize the embed response docs to show `embedding` (array of floats) and top-level `data` with index fields. Tests flagged a mismatch where examples returned `vector` key.

ci-bot: build-docs #1455 started for branch fix/quickstart-shape (triggered by pat)

pat: Pushed commit https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/aa11bb22: replaced instruction/input -> messages, converted max_new_tokens to numeric literals, added Content-Type header to curl, updated embed examples, added YAML comment for timeout_ms, and added compat note. Also added snip-080 test.

noor: I'll run docs-lint locally against that commit and report back. Thanks for moving quickly.

pat: Ran lint/tests locally: snippet-linter catches quoted numerics and legacy keys now. All docs-tests pass locally. Leaving a short CHANGELOG entry under docs/changes.md referencing snip-080.

ci-bot: build-docs #1455 succeeded for branch fix/quickstart-shape

jamie: CI green. Merging. Please open a follow-up issue to add an automated normalization step in the docs CI that coerces example JSON types and flags legacy keys before snippets run. That will reduce future flakes.

pat: Will open issue and link from PR description. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
